title: How a Sink P-Trap Protects Indoor Air Quality
description: The P-trap is a critical component located directly under fixture sinks, designed to hold a standing volume of water after every discharge. This standing water creates a continuous hydraulic seal that prevents hazardous sewer gases, foul odors, and pests from rising back into the building. As waste water enters the sink tailpiece, it pushes the old trapped water over the trap weir and into the branch drain, while fresh water remains behind to replenish the seal. Maintaining proper trap geometry guarantees smooth waste clearance without losing this vital liquid barrier.

How a Sink P-Trap Protects Indoor Air Quality

The P-trap is a critical component located directly under fixture sinks, designed to hold a standing volume of water after every discharge. This standing water creates a continuous hydraulic seal that prevents hazardous sewer gases, foul odors, and pests from rising back into the building. As waste water enters the sink tailpiece, it pushes the old trapped water over the trap weir and into the branch drain, while fresh water remains behind to replenish the seal. Maintaining proper trap geometry guarantees smooth waste clearance without losing this vital liquid barrier.
